title: Atlassian Design System A2UI catalog
description: A2UI v0.9 components rendered with the Atlassian Design System: text, layout, cards, inputs, and forms.
instructions: Send A2UI v0.9 messages, each with "version": "v0.9". Start with createSurface using this catalogId, then send updateComponents with a flat list of components. Each component needs a unique id and a component name from this catalog; reference children by id. Exactly one component must have the id "root". Use data bindings ({ "path": "/json/pointer" }) for values the user can change, and send updateDataModel to set initial values.

value.description: Stable identifier persisted to the data model.

Selected values. Always modelled as a string array so single- and multi-select share one wire shape. Written by the adapter when the user makes a selection (in both `style: select` and `style: action` modes — selection IS persisted in both). To know which option was just selected, agents either read this binding or encode per-option context into the `onChange` action JSON (see `onChange` description).

multiple.description: If true, allow multiple selections (renders as AK Select with `isMulti`). Defaults to `false`. Ignored when `style: action` (action menus only fire one option at a time).

style.description: Render style. `select` (default) renders as `@atlaskit/select`. `action` renders as `@atlaskit/dropdown-menu` — a menu of actions where picking an item writes the value to `value`'s binding AND fires `onChange`. Use `action` when you want a button-triggered menu UI; use `select` for the standard combobox.

placeholder.description: A literal string OR a `{ path }` JSON-pointer binding into the surface data model.

disabled.description: A literal boolean OR a `{ path }` JSON-pointer binding into the surface data model.

invalid.description: A literal boolean OR a `{ path }` JSON-pointer binding into the surface data model.

filterable.description: Show a typeahead filter. Defaults to true for AK Select. Ignored for action style.

onChange.description: Action dispatched after the picked value is written to the bound `value` path. The runtime always invokes onChange with zero arguments (per the upstream @a2ui binder contract); to know WHICH option was picked, the agent either reads the binding directly or encodes per-option context into the action JSON, e.g. `onChange: { event: { name: 'picked', context: { from: 'fruit-menu' } } }` — then inspects `context` in the surface's `onAction` callback. There is no way to receive the option value as a function argument; that is a fundamental constraint of how Actions cross the JSON wire.
